test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_lazy_materialization_no_offset_index.parquet', Parquet) SELECT number AS id, toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') + (number % 500000) * 12 + intDiv(number, 500000) AS t, toInt32(number % 1000) AS c, toInt32(cityHash64(number, 1) % 100000) AS region, toInt64(cityHash64(number, 2)) AS user, toInt16(number % 7) AS os, toInt16(number % 13) AS agent, toInt16(number % 3) AS refresh, toInt32(cityHash64(number, 3) % 4000) AS width, toInt32(cityHash64(number, 4) % 3000) AS height, toInt64(cityHash64(number, 5)) AS fuid, toInt64(cityHash64(number, 6)) AS url_hash, toInt64(cityHash64(number, 7)) AS referer_hash, toInt32(cityHash64(number, 8) % 1000000) AS remote_ip, toInt32(cityHash64(number, 9) % 10000) AS send_timing, toInt32(cityHash64(number, 10) % 10000) AS fetch_timing, toInt16(number % 100) AS age, toInt16(number % 2) AS sex, toInt64(cityHash64(number, 11) % 100000) AS price, concat('https://site', toString(number % 997), '.example/', hex(cityHash64(number, 12))) AS url, concat('https://ref', toString(number % 31), '.example/?q=', hex(cityHash64(number, 13))) AS referer, repeat('t', number % 64) AS title, if(number % 5 = 0, concat('search phrase ', toString(number % 1001)), '') AS phrase, concat('model-', toString(number % 211)) AS phone_model, concat('{{"a":', toString(number % 10007), ',"b":"', hex(cityHash64(number, 14)), '"}}') AS params, toString(number % 17) AS charset, concat('lang-', toString(number % 41)) AS language, concat('utm-', toString(number % 503)) AS utm_source, concat('utm-', toString(number % 1009)) AS utm_campaign, hex(cityHash64(number, 15)) AS order_id, concat('tag', toString(number % 97)) AS from_tag FROM numbers(6000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_write_page_index = 0, output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 500000, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1, max_block_size = 100000, max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT * FROM file('test_parquet_lazy_materialization_no_offset_index.parquet') ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM file('test_parquet_lazy_materialization_no_offset_index.parquet') WHERE c = 62 ORDER BY t LIMIT 100 FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM file('test_parquet_lazy_materialization_no_offset_index.parquet') WHERE phrase != '' ORDER BY t, id LIMIT 1000 FORMAT Null
